item.title: Amherst College, Facing Blowback Over Sexualized Orientation Ceremony Held in School Chapel, Seeks To Hire Christian Chaplin Who Will 'Advance Equity'
item.description: Amherst College has a Muslim chaplain, a Buddhist chaplain, and a Hindu chaplain. item.description: ROCK HILL, S.C.—Gavin Newsom, who is definitely running for president, is probably—inscrutably, appallingly—the early favorite to win the Democratic nomination in 2028. item.title: Bloodbath Imminent: CNN's Overpaid Hacks on Alert as Paramount Set To Acquire Failing Network's Parent Company
item.description: Paramount is closer than ever to acquiring CNN parent company Warner Bros. after Netflix declined to raise its bid for the media conglomerate. That's bad news for the failing network's stable of overpaid hacks, many of whom will be first in line for layoffs (or drastic salary reductions) once the acquisition goes through. item.title: A Tale of Two Reactions: Iranian Civilians Cheer, American Leftists Shriek as Trump Strikes Iran
item.description: In Tehran, the U.S. attack on Iran, dubbed "Operation Epic Fury," was met with cheers and dancing from civilians who laughed at the sight of a strike on an Iranian regime official's home and chanted, "I love Trump." In Washington, D.C., it was met with condemnation from left-wing pundits who called for President Donald Trump's impeachment.
